**Why the model made this decision**  
The model looks at a few key pieces of your credit profile.  
- **Revolving credit utilization (13.7 % of your limit used)** pulls the risk down. Using a small portion of your available credit shows you’re not relying heavily on borrowing, which the model sees as a positive sign.  
- **Age (35 years)** adds a small amount of risk. In the data the model was trained on, people in this age range have a slightly higher chance of missing a payment, so it nudges the score upward.
